description: This file contains internal structures, function declarations, and constants related to X.509 certificates within the OpenSSL cryptographic library. It defines data structures for certificates, CRLs, certificate policies, and cryptographic operations, primarily used for certificate validation and handling.

classes.name: X509_VAL
classes.description: Structure representing the validity period of an X.509 certificate.

classes.name: X509_PUBKEY
classes.description: Structure representing the public key information in an X.509 certificate.

classes.name: X509_NAME_ENTRY
classes.description: Entry in an X.509 distinguished name.

classes.name: X509_NAME
classes.description: Structure representing the distinguished name in an X.509 certificate.

classes.name: X509_CERT_AUX
classes.description: Auxiliary information for X.509 certificates, such as trust and rejection policies.

classes.name: X509_CINF
classes.description: Structure representing the core information of an X.509 certificate.

classes.name: X509
classes.description: Main structure representing an X.509 certificate.

classes.name: X509_REQ_INFO
classes.description: Structure representing the information in a certificate signing request.

classes.name: X509_req_st
classes.description: Structure representing a certificate signing request.

classes.name: X509_REVOKED
classes.description: Structure representing a revoked certificate in a CRL.

classes.name: X509_CRL_INFO
classes.description: Structure representing the core information of a CRL.

classes.name: X509_VERIFY_PARAM_st
classes.description: Structure for parameters used during certificate verification.

classes.name: X509_OBJECT
classes.description: Union type for different X.509 related objects.

classes.name: X509_LOOKUP_METHOD
classes.description: Structure defining methods for X.509 lookup operations.

classes.name: X509_STORE
classes.description: Structure representing a store of trusted certificates and related data.

classes.name: X509_LOOKUP
classes.description: Structure for performing certificate lookup operations.

classes.name: X509_STORE_CTX
classes.description: Context used during certificate chain verification.

methods.name: ASN1_generate_v3
methods.description: Generates an ASN.1 object with version 3 extensions based on a string and context.

methods.name: X509_CERT_AUX_print
methods.description: Prints auxiliary X.509 certificate info to a BIO.

methods.name: x509_rsa_pss_to_ctx
methods.description: Configures an EVP_MD_CTX for RSA-PSS signing based on signature algorithm parameters.

methods.name: x509_rsa_ctx_to_pss
methods.description: Sets RSA-PSS parameters in an X509_ALGOR based on a signing context.

methods.name: x509_digest_sign_algorithm
methods.description: Encodes signing parameters into an AlgorithmIdentifier.

methods.name: x509_digest_verify_init
methods.description: Prepares a verification context with public key and signature algorithm.

methods.name: X509_policy_check
methods.description: Checks certificate policies in a chain against user policies and flags.
